## Incident Categories & Severity  
### Incident Types  
**1. Cybersecurity Incident**
- Malware infection
- Ransomware attack
- Unauthorized access
- Data exfiltration
- DDoS attack
- Credential compromise  
**2. Data Breach**
- Customer personal data exposed
- Financial data accessed
- System/operational data leaked
- Regulatory data breached  
**3. System Incident**
- System outage/unavailability
- Data corruption
- Performance degradation
- Integration failure
- Backup failure  
**4. Physical Security Incident**
- Facility breach
- Equipment theft
- Fire/environmental damage
- Access control failure  
**5. Fraud/Misconduct**
- Unauthorized transactions
- Employee fraud
- Third-party fraud

raw_entities.name: Cybersecurity Incident
raw_entities.description: A security event involving malicious software, unauthorized system access, credential compromise, or network-based attacks. Subtypes include malware infection, ransomware attack, unauthorized access, data exfiltration, DDoS attack, and credential compromise. Each subtype has distinct containment and recovery requirements.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: An incident involving unauthorized exposure or access to sensitive data held by the bank. Subtypes include customer personal data exposure, financial data access, system/operational data leakage, and regulatory data breach. Each requires specific notification and remediation protocols.

raw_entities.name: System Incident
raw_entities.description: An operational or technical failure affecting banking systems, data integrity, or service availability. Subtypes include system outage/unavailability, data corruption, performance degradation, integration failure, and backup failure. Recovery procedures vary by subtype and impact scope.

raw_entities.name: Physical Security Incident
raw_entities.description: An incident involving unauthorized physical access to bank facilities, loss or damage to equipment, or failure of physical access controls. Subtypes include facility breach, equipment theft, fire/environmental damage, and access control failure. Requires coordination with physical security and facilities teams.

raw_entities.name: Fraud and Misconduct Incident
raw_entities.description: An incident involving fraudulent activity or misconduct by employees or third parties. Subtypes include unauthorized transactions, employee fraud, and third-party fraud. Requires investigation, potential law enforcement notification, and customer remediation.
